author: JustinGalarza22
quote: Nah i don't know what to say. The fire and passion that was once grand theft auto is gone. This game has been completely watered down. Everything is modern and a bad modern. The combat is fine. The driving is fine. The graphics are fine but the story it's just not good yeah it's a rockstar game and it follows the same rockstar formula but it's the worst rockstar game they have made so far. It's just bland. It's like butter toast on one bread. It's nothing special at all this is legitimately heartbreaking. I wish the story had more special memorable moments, but I'm just bored out of my mind. I legit don't wanna play the game anymore like I understand people saying it gets better but **** makes me feel like this what am I supposed to do?
